title: hold_source_observation_admission doesn't stamp when only source_observation_admission_held flips, leaving a stale queueHold until an unrelated mutation
outcome: When a retained source observation engages its admission hold on a session whose latch and preview already match, the session's changed queueHold is still published.
acceptance: hold_source_observation_admission (src/engram_source_sightings.rs) reports changed when it sets source_observation_admission_held from false to true, even when the latch and the preview were already set, so every caller (retry tick, turn_dispatch capacity resume, source-observation recovery) stamps and publishes.

A regression test sets up a session whose latch and preview already equal the barrier's, with a scheduled automatic retry projected as queueHold, then engages the hold and asserts that the hold change is stamped and published (the queueHold projection is cleared in the published state).
